title: The Marathas And Nizam Ul Mulk
definition: The geopolitical struggle between the rising Maratha Confederacy and the autonomous Hyderabad state established by Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah I, defining the power vacuum in the Deccan post-Aurangzeb.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the decline of the Mughal Empire, the shift from centralized authority to regional successor states, and the Maratha expansionist policy (Chauth and Sardeshmukhi).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Marathas And Nizam Ul Mulk.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
